name: @cloudsforge/custody
description: Key custody: HD seeds, key generation, the encryption envelope, the signing policy, treasury pins, the key lifecycle and the export ceremony.

scripts._test: --test-concurrency=1 is required, not a preference: the database test files truncate custody's tables between cases and node:test runs FILES in parallel by default. A TRUNCATE takes an AccessExclusiveLock, so one file's reset deadlocks against another file's inserts (40P01).

_localDependencies: The @cloudsforge/* packages are consumed from sibling checkouts because none of them is
published yet. The runtime packages take 'file:' and the contracts packages take 'link:' —
'link:' symlinks the package in place so it keeps using its own already-installed
node_modules, which is what a 'workspace:^' transitive needs.
@cloudsforge/contracts-chain is EXACT-PINNED rather than caret-ranged. Confirmation depths and
chain ids must agree byte-for-byte between wallet, settlement, custody and indexer; a skew is
not a 500, it is a signature bound to the wrong network.
